name: UCAP Cloud Information Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: UCAP Cloud Information Technology Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of software products in China. The company offers intelligent computing solutions, including multimodal training and propulsion fusion, inference all-in-one machine, and enlightenment box. It also provides enlightenment platform products, such as enlightened intelligent agent platform to integrate internal information, processes, and large models; and enlightenment big model operations management system to simplify the training, development, deployment, and maintenance of models.
